capabilities: Publish a note to a shareable web page via ribbon, command palette, or file menu
Upload local vault images and embed them on the published page
Store published URLs and expiration dates in note properties
List, republish, unpublish, and copy links for published notes
Control page theme, branding, and password protection from Obsidian
extras: Freemium: links last 30 days without an account, 90 days with a free account, permanent with Pro; themes, hidden branding, and password protection require Pro. Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Publishes to api.jotbird.com; states no telemetry is collected.
problem: Sharing a single note as a public web page normally means copying content to another tool or setting up publishing infrastructure.
summary: Publishing service client that turns notes into shareable web pages on JotBird, with image uploads and frontmatter-tracked links.
